bagPolicy.summary: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium follows the NFL's clear bag policy to ensure safety and speed up entry. Fans can bring clear bags up to 12x6x12 inches or small clutches no larger than 4.5x6.5 inches.
allowed: Non-clear bags no larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: Fanny Packs or Belt Bags larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
bagPolicy.note: An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection.

parking.note: Parking at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium is managed with a counter-clockwise traffic flow. The parking lot is determined by the tollgate entered and the type of parking pass held. Parking staff will direct traffic based on availability.

rideshare.note: Guests and ride-sharing services such as zTrip, Uber, and Lyft may drop-off and pick-up at the Missouri Welcome Center located between Gates 1 and 2 on Blue Ridge Cutoff.

concessions.note: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium offers a variety of premium seating options with all-inclusive food and beverage services. Highlights include the Kingdom Club and Bud Light Locker Room Club, which provide specialty drinks and access to exclusive areas. Tailgate Suites and Champions Tailgate offer catered buffets and tailgate fare.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible/wheelchair seating is located on the Field, Community America Club and Ford Fan Zone Levels. There are men's and women's restrooms located on each level of GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium; each is an ADA accessible facility.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Chiefs Games: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff.
